tickets.title: Evaluate lapse and reinstatement for policy
tickets.text: Evaluate the lapse and possible reinstatement of Soren Cloudpuddle’s $750,000 20‑year Paper Otter Life term policy after a premium draft failure from his Teacup Comet Bank checking account when it was replaced, to preserve existing underwriting terms.
tickets.evidence: 2024-12-13 agreed: evaluate lapse/reinstatement after notice showed draft failure when checking was replaced, before losing existing underwriting terms.

tickets.title: Review term coverage and disability protection
tickets.text: Review Soren Cloudpuddle’s term life coverage and disability protection in light of Lila Cloudpuddle’s shift to part‑time employment, which raises household reliance on his salary and heightens exposure from their $620,000 mortgage, childcare and education funding needs.
tickets.evidence: 2024-12-20 agreed: review term-coverage/disability-protection after Lila reduced paid-work to part-time, increasing household dependence on his salary, with mortgage/childcare/education-funding exposure.
